name: Sonnet Mondal

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sonnet Mondal is a Kolkata-based poet writing in English, an editor and the founder director of Chair Poetry Evenings. He founded Verseville and has edited the Indian section of Lyrikline. His poetry collections include “An Afternoon in My Mind” and “Clamour for a Handful of Rice”, both published by Copper Coin, and his writing has travelled through translation and international poetry festivals.

The two poems gathered here listen closely to the beginning of a day. “Dawn on the banks of Ganga” gathers a ferry rope, shadows, birds and a village’s stillness into a hushed river scene. “Until Next Morning” begins amid traffic and opening shops before daylight becomes a force of separation. Everyday sounds lead towards questions of time, intimacy and loss.
